name: Google Drive Sync
tagline: Effortlessly synchronize your chats and settings with Google Drive.

labels.inputSource: Source to read (legacy files are read-only)

operations.selectInput: Choose an existing sync folder or legacy file

actions.retryDescription: Sync is already unlocked. Send this device’s pending changes.
actions.connectDescription: Connect Google Drive so this device can sync chats and settings.
actions.reconnectDescription: Your Google session has expired. Sign in again to resume syncing.
actions.createDescription: Create a new encrypted sync folder from the current chats and settings. Legacy files are left unchanged.
actions.pullTitle: Load the selected Google Drive file into this device
actions.pullDescription: Replace local conversations and settings with the selected source. Legacy files are read-only. Reading an encrypted folder enables sync with that folder.
actions.pushTitle: Force overwrite the selected Google Drive file with this device's local data
actions.pushDescription: Update the current encrypted sync folder with local conversations and settings. Legacy files are never written.
actions.disconnectDescription: This only stops syncing and signs out of Google for this app. Your local chats remain on this device, and your Google Drive files are not deleted or cleared.
actions.resumeDescription: Unlock and upload pending changes from this device. On a new device, download the cloud data first.

notice: The key is saved in this browser to resume sync after reload. The passphrase is not saved. Conflicting edits stop for your review.
privacy: Your privacy is important to us. To protect it, Weavelet Canvas only requests non-sensitive access, which means it can only create, view, and manage its own files and folders.

toast.pull: Loaded cloud data into this device.
toast.push: Cloud file overwritten with local data.

status.idleAwaitingChoice: Auto-sync is waiting for you to choose the sync direction.
status.idleDisconnected: Google Drive Sync is not connected.

encryption.help: Use at least 12 characters when creating a folder. Use the same passphrase on other devices. Lost passphrases cannot be recovered. Google can still see file sizes and update times.
encryption.legacy: Legacy files are read-only. To migrate, download the legacy file and create an encrypted folder. The old file is not deleted automatically.
encryption.failed: Sync did not complete. Local data remains saved.
encryption.disconnectBeforeDelete: Disconnect before deleting the current sync target.
encryption.folderNameHelp: Choose or enter a name. An existing sync folder with the same name adds a number when creating the new folder; it is not overwritten.

guidance.enterNewPassphrase: Enter a new sync passphrase with at least 12 characters.
guidance.passphraseTooShort: The passphrase is shorter than 12 characters. Enter at least 12 characters.
guidance.confirmPassphrase: Enter the same passphrase in the confirmation field.
guidance.enterPassphrase: Enter the passphrase for the existing encrypted sync folder.
guidance.createOrRead: Create an encrypted sync folder or read an existing encrypted folder first.
guidance.connect: Press the Connect to Google Drive button.
guidance.reconnect: Press the Reconnect to Google Drive button.
guidance.create: Both entries match. Press the Create encrypted sync folder button.
guidance.resume: Press the Unlock and resume sync button.
guidance.active: Changes are encrypted and saved automatically. You can close this dialog.
guidance.pull: Check the source, then press the button to replace local data with cloud data.
guidance.push: Press the upload button to update the encrypted sync folder with local data.

progress.measurement: Percentage applies to the current upload phase. Sizes and average transfer speeds update when each file completes. Phases with unknown totals have no percentage.

conflict.description: Conflicting messages become branches within the chat; matching branches are combined. Conflicting chat metadata or folders are kept as separate copies. Conflicting settings use this device’s values.

backendNotice: Google credentials are encrypted on Cloudflare and refreshed automatically. Conversations are encrypted in the browser. The sync key is remembered in this browser; the passphrase is neither stored nor sent.

review.description: Sync changed this chat. Review its other branches too.
